hosted-lossless-delayed-50ms.description: Deterministic lossless 50 ms ACK-path-delay scenario shared by tcpcc and the pinned native Linux reference.

topology_bindings.tcpcc: host TUN egress delays host-to-guest ACK traffic
topology_bindings.native-linux: receiver network namespace veth egress delays receiver-to-sender ACK traffic

tcp_loss_counters.reason: TCP lost/retrans/total_retrans are preserved for native parity analysis; the lossless gate applies to the configured zero-loss qdisc instead of assuming runtime scheduling cannot trigger TCP recovery.

native_parity.reason: The native reference must boot the pinned Linux source; the GitHub runner host kernel is never accepted as a substitute.
